doc.title: Mickey Roker interviewed by Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 31, 1995

title: Arriving in New York unable to read; Mary Lou Williams at the Hickory House
summary: Roker came out of the Army unable to read music, played with Gigi Gryce, Ray Bryant and Joe Williams, then about a year off and on with Mary Lou Williams.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Tell us some of the other people that you’ve backed up. I noticed you worked with Nancy Wilson.

Yes. Well see when I first went to New York I didn’t know how to read music. You know I studied very briefly and then I got drafted in the Army. So when I came out of the Army I went to New York to play with Gigi, then I played with Ray Bryant, then Joe Williams. And when I left Joe Williams I took a gig with Mary Lou Williams in the Hickory House. And I worked with her for about a year off and on, then she got sick. So
